pairs.target: jiǎnzǐ tiēzhe bùdài hé le yíxià .
pairs.english: The scissors closed once against the cloth belt.
pairs.hanzi: 剪子贴着布带合了一下。

pairs.target: lín zhào de yāo měngdì bēngjǐn , yùbèi zhe nà zhèn chě tòng , duànkāi de dàizǐ què zhǐ sōngsōngdì chuíxiàlái .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao's waist tensed sharply, braced for that pulling pain, but the severed belt merely hung loose.
pairs.hanzi: 林照的腰猛地绷紧，预备着那阵扯痛，断开的带子却只松松地垂下来。

pairs.target: fùrén yòng yíkuài gānjìng bù jīn zhēzhù tā shēn qián , jiào pángbiān de rén bǎ tóngpén nuó jìn .
pairs.english: The woman covered Lin Zhao's front with a clean cloth and told the person beside her to bring the copper basin closer.
pairs.hanzi: 妇人用一块干净布巾遮住她身前，叫旁边的人把铜盆挪近。

pairs.target: wēnshuǐ yìdiǎndiǎn rùn jìn jiù bù , yīn kāi de yánsè bǐ tā jìde de shēn .
pairs.english: Warm water slowly soaked into the old cloth; the spreading stain was darker than she remembered.
pairs.hanzi: 温水一点点润进旧布，洇开的颜色比她记得的深。

pairs.target: tā dīng zhe péngdǐng .
pairs.english: She stared at the shed roof.
pairs.hanzi: 她盯着棚顶。

pairs.target: dǐng bù shàng yǒu jǐchù bǔdīng , zuìdà de yíkuài yā zài héngliáng biān , zhēnjiǎo wāiwāidì zǒu chūqù , dào le jiǎo shàng , yòu zhé le huílái .
pairs.english: There were several patches on the canvas, the largest one pressed beside a crossbeam; crooked stitches wandered out, then turned back at a corner.
pairs.hanzi: 顶布上有几处补丁，最大的一块压在横梁边，针脚歪歪地走出去，到了角上，又折了回来。

pairs.target: " lěng jiù shuō . "
pairs.english: “Say if you're cold,”
pairs.hanzi: “冷就说。”

pairs.target: fùrén dào .
pairs.english: the woman said.
pairs.hanzi: 妇人道。

pairs.target: tā yáotóu , yáchǐ què kē le yíxià .
pairs.english: She shook her head, but her teeth knocked together once.
pairs.hanzi: 她摇头，牙齿却磕了一下。

pairs.target: fùrén méi zài wèn , bǎ báobèi wǎng tā tuǐ shàng yè jǐn .
pairs.english: The woman asked no more, tucking the thin quilt snugly around her legs.
pairs.hanzi: 妇人没再问，把薄被往她腿上掖紧。

pairs.target: hòulái téng háishì lái le .
pairs.english: The pain came eventually, all the same.
pairs.hanzi: 后来疼还是来了。

pairs.target: búshì yuánxiān nàzhǒng yídòng biàn chězhù de téng , xìxì mìmì , cóng yāo cè wǎngshàngpá .
pairs.english: It wasn't the old sort of pain, catching as soon as she moved, but a fine, close pain creeping upward from her side.
pairs.hanzi: 不是原先那种一动便扯住的疼，细细密密，从腰侧往上爬。

pairs.target: tā de shǒu zhuā búdào bèi jiǎo , biàn mōsuǒ zhe zuàn zhù chuángyán , zhǐjiān pèngdào yídào mù cì , yě méishōu huíqù .
pairs.english: Her hand could not reach the quilt's corner, so she felt along the bed's edge and gripped it; her fingertips touched a splinter but still did not pull away.
pairs.hanzi: 她的手抓不到被角，便摸索着攥住床沿，指尖碰到一道木刺，也没收回去。

pairs.target: " dài niángzǐ , shuǐ . "
pairs.english: “Mistress Dai, water.”
pairs.hanzi: “戴娘子，水。”

pairs.target: yǒurén cóng tā tóudǐng dì guò dōngxī .
pairs.english: Someone passed something over her head.
pairs.hanzi: 有人从她头顶递过东西。

pairs.target: lín zhàokàn bù qīng , zhǐjiàn fùrén jiē le , xiùzǐ huáxiàlái yì jié , tā téng chūshǒu , yòu wǎn le shàngqù .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao couldn't see clearly, only that the woman took it, her sleeve slipped down a little, and she freed a hand and rolled it up again.
pairs.hanzi: 林照看不清，只见妇人接了，袖子滑下来一截，她腾出手，又挽了上去。

pairs.target: tā xiǎng wèn háiyào duōjiǔ , chūkǒu de quèshì yìshēng chuǎnxī .
pairs.english: She wanted to ask how much longer, but what came out was a gasp.
pairs.hanzi: 她想问还要多久，出口的却是一声喘息。

pairs.target: dài niángzǐ tíng le yíhuìer , děng tā huǎn guò qì , cái dīshēng shuō xià yíbù yào pèng nǎlǐ .
pairs.english: Mistress Dai paused a while, waited for her breathing to settle, then quietly explained where she would touch next.
pairs.hanzi: 戴娘子停了一会儿，等她缓过气，才低声说下一步要碰哪里。

pairs.target: lín zhào tīngjiàn le , bìng bù juéde néng shǎo téng yìxiē , kě nà zhī shǒu zài kào guòlái shí , tā méiyǒu wǎnghòu duǒ .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao heard; she didn't think it could lessen the pain even a little, but when the hand approached again, she didn't shrink back.
pairs.hanzi: 林照听见了，并不觉得能少疼一些，可那只手再靠过来时，她没有往后躲。

pairs.target: děng xīn bù fù shàngqù , tā yǐjīng fēnbùqīng guò le duōjiǔ .
pairs.english: By the time fresh cloth covered the wound, she could no longer tell how long it had been.
pairs.hanzi: 等新布覆上去，她已经分不清过了多久。

pairs.target: bèizi xiāndòng , jiǎo shàng de xié yě sōng le .
pairs.english: The quilt stirred, and the shoes on her feet loosened too.
pairs.hanzi: 被子掀动，脚上的鞋也松了。

pairs.target: tā měngdì táitóu , dài niángzǐ zhèng tuō zhe tā de jiǎogēn , lìngyìrén tì tā jiěkāi xiédài .
pairs.english: She raised her head sharply: Mistress Dai was supporting her heel while another person untied her shoelaces.
pairs.hanzi: 她猛地抬头，戴娘子正托着她的脚跟，另一人替她解开鞋带。

pairs.target: zhǒngqǐ de jiǎobèi lùchū lái , yánsè fāqīng .
pairs.english: The swollen instep came into view, bluish in color.
pairs.hanzi: 肿起的脚背露出来，颜色发青。

pairs.target: xié bèi fàngdào chuáng xià , liǎngzhī dōu zài , xié kǒu cháozhe wàimiàn .
pairs.english: The shoes were placed beneath the bed, both still there, their openings facing out.
pairs.hanzi: 鞋被放到床下，两只都在，鞋口朝着外面。

pairs.target: " zhèér yě pèng guò ? "
pairs.english: “Did you hurt this spot too?”
pairs.hanzi: “这儿也碰过？”

pairs.target: tā diǎntóu .
pairs.english: She nodded.
pairs.hanzi: 她点头。

pairs.target: dài niángzǐ yòu wèn le jǐjù , shēngyīn yǒushí jìn , yǒushí yuǎn .
pairs.english: Mistress Dai asked a few more questions, her voice sometimes near, sometimes far away.
pairs.hanzi: 戴娘子又问了几句，声音有时近，有时远。

pairs.target: lín zhào jìde zìjǐ shuō le jiǎozhǐ néngdòng , hòulái lián zìjǐ yǒuméiyǒu dá shàng , dōu búdàqīngchǔ .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao remembered saying she could move her toes; later, she wasn't even sure whether she herself had answered.
pairs.hanzi: 林照记得自己说了脚趾能动，后来连自己有没有答上，都不大清楚。

pairs.target: yījīn sōngkāi shí , tā hūrán mō xiàng xiōngqián .
pairs.english: As her lapels loosened, she suddenly reached toward her chest.
pairs.hanzi: 衣襟松开时，她忽然摸向胸前。

pairs.target: " bié diū . "
pairs.english: “Don't throw it away.”
pairs.hanzi: “别丢。”

pairs.target: dài niángzǐ shùnzhe tā de shǒu , cóng yī lǐ qǔchū nà zhāng zhé zhe de zhǐ .
pairs.english: Following her hand, Mistress Dai took the folded paper out of her clothes.
pairs.hanzi: 戴娘子顺着她的手，从衣里取出那张折着的纸。

pairs.target: zhǐbiān zhòu ruǎn , tiē zài yìqǐ , fùrén méiyǒu zhǎnkāi , zhǐ gē zài tā gòudézhe de zhěnbiān .
pairs.english: Its edges were wrinkled and soft, stuck together; the woman didn't unfold it, only laid it by her pillow, within reach.
pairs.hanzi: 纸边皱软，贴在一起，妇人没有展开，只搁在她够得着的枕边。

pairs.target: yāodài hé shuǐnáng yě nálái le , fàngzài chuángtóu de xiǎo dèng shàng .
pairs.english: The pouch and waterskin were brought over too and set on the small stool at the head of the bed.
pairs.hanzi: 腰袋和水囊也拿来了，放在床头的小凳上。

alignment.english: at the head of the bed

pairs.target: tā de shǒu hái xiàngzhe zhǐ , bàntú luòxiàqù .
pairs.english: Her hand was still reaching toward the paper when it dropped halfway.
pairs.hanzi: 她的手还向着纸，半途落下去。

pairs.target: zài xǐnglái , pénglǐ yǐjīng diǎn le dēng .
pairs.english: When she woke again, the shed already had a lamp lit.
pairs.hanzi: 再醒来，棚里已经点了灯。

pairs.target: dēngyàn bù gāo , qiángshàng de rényǐng què hěndà .
pairs.english: The flame was low, but the shadows on the wall were enormous.
pairs.hanzi: 灯焰不高，墙上的人影却很大。

pairs.target: gé zhe liǎngzhāng kōngchuáng , dài niángzǐ zuòzài ménbiān chīfàn , wǎn gē zài xī shàng , chī liǎngkǒu , biàn cháo wàitou dá yíjù .
pairs.english: Two empty beds away, Mistress Dai sat by the door eating, her bowl resting on her knees; every couple of mouthfuls she gave a reply to someone outside.
pairs.hanzi: 隔着两张空床，戴娘子坐在门边吃饭，碗搁在膝上，吃两口，便朝外头答一句。

pairs.target: lín zhàokàn zhe nà zhī wǎn , hūrán xiǎngqǐ zìjǐ hái méi fùqián .
pairs.english: Looking at the bowl, Lin Zhao suddenly remembered she still hadn't paid.
pairs.hanzi: 林照看着那只碗，忽然想起自己还没付钱。

pairs.target: tā chēng le yíxiàchuáng , yāo shàng de xīn bù lìkè yā dé tā xīqì .
pairs.english: She pushed against the bed once, and the fresh cloth at her waist immediately pressed so hard she sucked in a breath.
pairs.hanzi: 她撑了一下床，腰上的新布立刻压得她吸气。

pairs.target: dài niángzǐ bǎ wǎn fàngxià , guòlái fúzhù tā .
pairs.english: Mistress Dai set the bowl down and came to steady her.
pairs.hanzi: 戴娘子把碗放下，过来扶住她。

pairs.target: " yào shénme ? "
pairs.english: “What do you need?”
pairs.hanzi: “要什么？”

pairs.target: " shuǐ . "
pairs.english: “Water.”

pairs.target: shuǐ cóng bēi yán zhān dào zuǐchún shàng , wēn de .
pairs.english: Water touched her lips from the cup's rim, warm.
pairs.hanzi: 水从杯沿沾到嘴唇上，温的。

pairs.target: tā jí zhe wǎng xiàyàn , dài niángzǐ què jiāng bēizi yíkāi , ràng tā chuǎn yún le zài hē .
pairs.english: She was eager to swallow it down, but Mistress Dai moved the cup away, letting her catch her breath before drinking more.
pairs.hanzi: 她急着往下咽，戴娘子却将杯子移开，让她喘匀了再喝。

pairs.target: dìèrhuí tā hē dé màn , shégēn nà gǔ yòu kǔ yòu sè de wèidào cái dàn xiàqù .
pairs.english: The second time she drank slowly; only then did the taste at the root of her tongue, both bitter and astringent, begin to fade.
pairs.hanzi: 第二回她喝得慢，舌根那股又苦又涩的味道才淡下去。

alignment.english: at the root of her tongue

pairs.target: " zhè shì nǎér ? "
pairs.english: “Where is this?”
pairs.hanzi: “这是哪儿？”

pairs.target: " jiù cǎi chǎngxià tóu , yùn liào de péngzǐ .
pairs.english: “Below the old quarry, the sheds for hauling materials.”
pairs.hanzi: “旧采场下头，运料的棚子。

pairs.target: nǐ xiān tǎng zhe , bié xiǎng xià chuáng . "
pairs.english: “You lie still for now; don't think of getting out of bed.”
pairs.hanzi: 你先躺着，别想下床。”

pairs.target: lín zhào wàng xiàng ménkǒu , zhǐ kànjiàn yèsè lǐ yìjiǎo chēlún .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao looked toward the doorway, seeing only part of a cartwheel in the darkness.
pairs.hanzi: 林照望向门口，只看见夜色里一角车轮。

pairs.target: láishí nàtiáo lù yǒu duōcháng , tā quán méi jìzhù .
pairs.english: She had no memory at all of how long the road here had been.
pairs.hanzi: 来时那条路有多长，她全没记住。

pairs.target: " nǐjiā zài nǎér ? "
pairs.english: “Where is your home?”
pairs.hanzi: “你家在哪儿？”

pairs.target: " lì jīn . "
pairs.english: “Lijin.”
pairs.hanzi: “砾津。”

pairs.target: dài niángzǐ děng le yíhuìer .
pairs.english: Mistress Dai waited a while.
pairs.hanzi: 戴娘子等了一会儿。

pairs.target: lín zhào yě zhīdào zhǐ shuō liǎnggè zì búgòu .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao knew too that saying just two words wasn't enough.
pairs.hanzi: 林照也知道只说两个字不够。

pairs.target: chénglǐ nàme duōtiáo jiē , nàme duō huòzhàn , zhōu shěn míngzǎo hái huì zhàocháng chūmén , děngdào wǎnshàng , huòxǔ yòu gāi zài guō lǐ duō tiān yìpiáo shuǐ .
pairs.english: So many streets in the city, so many warehouses; Aunt Zhou would still go out as usual tomorrow morning, and by evening perhaps she ought to add another ladle of water to the pot.
pairs.hanzi: 城里那么多条街，那么多货栈，周婶明早还会照常出门，等到晚上，或许又该在锅里多添一瓢水。

pairs.target: " wǒ zìjǐ huíqù . "
pairs.english: “I will go back myself,”
pairs.hanzi: “我自己回去。”

pairs.target: tā shuō .
pairs.english: she said.
pairs.hanzi: 她说。

pairs.target: " néng huíqù de shíhòu zàishuō . "
pairs.english: “We can talk about going back when you're able to.”
pairs.hanzi: “能回去的时候再说。”

pairs.target: dài niángzǐ bǎ bēizi gē hǎo , zhuǎnshēn duān huí le tā nà wǎnfàn .
pairs.english: Mistress Dai set the cup down, turned and took up her bowl of food again.
pairs.hanzi: 戴娘子把杯子搁好，转身端回了她那碗饭。

pairs.target: méiyǒu rén bī tā jiēzhe jiǎng .
pairs.english: No one forced her to go on.
pairs.hanzi: 没有人逼她接着讲。

pairs.target: ménwài de shuōhuàshēng jiànjiàn sàn le , dēngxīn bào le yìdiǎn xiǎohuā .
pairs.english: The voices outside the door gradually dispersed, and a tiny flower burst from the lampwick.
pairs.hanzi: 门外的说话声渐渐散了，灯芯爆了一点小花。

pairs.target: lín zhào bǎshǒu nuó dào zhěnbiān , zhǐ jiǎo guāguò zhǐ fù , tā biàn tíng zài nàlǐ .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao moved her hand beside the pillow; the paper's corner scraped her fingertip, and she stopped right there.
pairs.hanzi: 林照把手挪到枕边，纸角刮过指腹，她便停在那里。

pairs.target: yèlǐ tā shāo qǐlái , shuì dé hěn suì .
pairs.english: She grew feverish that night and slept in fragments.
pairs.hanzi: 夜里她烧起来，睡得很碎。

pairs.target: yǒushí yì zhēngyǎn , dài niángzǐ hái zài , yǒushí huàn le gè dǎkēshuì de niánqīngrén , dèng jiǎo zhī zài chuángbiān .
pairs.english: Sometimes she opened her eyes and Mistress Dai was still there; sometimes a young man took her place, dozing, his stool legs propped beside the bed.
pairs.hanzi: 有时一睁眼，戴娘子还在，有时换了个打瞌睡的年轻人，凳脚支在床边。

pairs.target: tā xiǎng jiào zhōu shěn , sǎngzi lǐ hánhùn dì xiǎng le liǎngshēng , nà rén biàn jīngxǐng , còu guòlái wèn tā yào buyào shuǐ .
pairs.english: She wanted to call Aunt Zhou; a couple of indistinct sounds came from her throat, then the man woke with a start and leaned over to ask if she wanted water.
pairs.hanzi: 她想叫周婶，嗓子里含混地响了两声，那人便惊醒，凑过来问她要不要水。

pairs.target: tā kànqīng tā de liǎn , yáo le yáotóu .
pairs.english: She saw his face clearly and shook her head.
pairs.hanzi: 她看清他的脸，摇了摇头。

pairs.target: dìèrrì dàbàn yě zài hūnshuì lǐ guòqù .
pairs.english: Most of the second day passed in drowsy sleep too.
pairs.hanzi: 第二日大半也在昏睡里过去。

pairs.target: xǐng zhe de shíhòu , yǒurén wèi tā jǐkǒu xīzhōu , huàn yāo shàng de bù , mō tā étóu .
pairs.english: When she was awake, someone fed her a few mouthfuls of thin gruel, changed the cloth at her waist and felt her forehead.
pairs.hanzi: 醒着的时候，有人喂她几口稀粥，换腰上的布，摸她额头。

pairs.target: tā tīngjiàn péngwài zhàocháng zhuāngchē , shí tiáo luò zài mùjià shàng , yìshēng jiē yìshēng , dào le bàngwǎn cái tíng .
pairs.english: She heard carts being loaded outside as usual, stone blocks landing on wooden frames, one thud after another; only at dusk did it stop.
pairs.hanzi: 她听见棚外照常装车，石条落在木架上，一声接一声，到了傍晚才停。

pairs.target: tā méi zài shì zhe zuò qǐlái .
pairs.english: She didn't try to sit up again.
pairs.hanzi: 她没再试着坐起来。

pairs.target: dìsānrì zǎoshàng , sòng zhōu de rén bǎ wǎn gēxià , qù nuó ménbiān àishì de zhúkuāng .
pairs.english: On the morning of the third day, the person bringing gruel set the bowl down and went to move a bamboo basket blocking the doorway.
pairs.hanzi: 第三日早上，送粥的人把碗搁下，去挪门边碍事的竹筐。

pairs.target: lín zhào wàng zhe wǎnkǒu nà lǚ rèqì , mànmàn bǎshǒu cóng bèizi lǐ shēnchū lái .
pairs.english: Watching the wisp of steam above the bowl, Lin Zhao slowly reached her hand out from under the quilt.
pairs.hanzi: 林照望着碗口那缕热气，慢慢把手从被子里伸出来。

pairs.target: tā xiān pèngdào sháo bǐng , yòu suōhuíqù .
pairs.english: She touched the spoon handle first, then drew back.
pairs.hanzi: 她先碰到勺柄，又缩回去。

pairs.target: zhǎngxīn yuánxiān nà chù cāshāng hái nèn zhe , pèngyìng dōngxī réng téng .
pairs.english: The old scrape on her palm was still tender; touching anything hard still hurt.
pairs.hanzi: 掌心原先那处擦伤还嫩着，碰硬东西仍疼。

pairs.target: tā huàn le zhī shǒu , wòzhù sháozǐ , yǎo dé tài mǎn , zhōu yánzhe bǐng tǎng dào shǒuzhǐ shàng .
pairs.english: She changed hands and gripped the spoon, scooping too much; gruel ran along the handle onto her fingers.
pairs.hanzi: 她换了只手，握住勺子，舀得太满，粥沿着柄淌到手指上。

pairs.target: sòng zhōu de rén huílái , zhèngyào jiē , tā bǎshǒu wǎng lǐ shōu le shōu .
pairs.english: The person bringing gruel returned and was about to take over, but she drew her hand inward.
pairs.hanzi: 送粥的人回来，正要接，她把手往里收了收。

pairs.target: " wǒ lái . "
pairs.english: “I will do it.”
pairs.hanzi: “我来。”

pairs.target: tā biàn méi jiē , zhǐ jiāng dèngzǐ nuó jìn , bǎ wǎn fàng dé dī xiē .
pairs.english: So he didn't take it, only moved the stool closer and set the bowl lower.
pairs.hanzi: 他便没接，只将凳子挪近，把碗放得低些。

pairs.target: lín zhào kàozhe diàn qǐ de pūgài , mànmàn chī le bànwǎn .
pairs.english: Leaning against the propped-up bedding, Lin Zhao slowly ate half a bowl.
pairs.hanzi: 林照靠着垫起的铺盖，慢慢吃了半碗。

pairs.target: yāo cè yīrán téng , zuò jiǔ le , bèishàng biàn chūhàn , jiǎobèi yě hái zhǒng zhe .
pairs.english: Her side still hurt; when she sat too long, sweat broke out on her back, and her instep was still swollen.
pairs.hanzi: 腰侧依然疼，坐久了，背上便出汗，脚背也还肿着。

pairs.target: kě sháozǐ cóng wǎn lǐ dào zuǐbiān , zhè yìxiǎo duàn lù , zǒngsuàn búyòng biérén tì tā zǒu le .
pairs.english: But on that short journey from bowl to mouth with the spoon, at last she no longer needed someone else to carry it for her.
pairs.hanzi: 可勺子从碗里到嘴边，这一小段路，总算不用别人替她走了。

pairs.target: chī wán , tā bǎ sháozǐ fàng huí wǎn lǐ , shēnshǒu mō dào zhěn xià .
pairs.english: When she had finished eating, she returned the spoon to the bowl and reached to feel beneath the pillow.
pairs.hanzi: 吃完，她把勺子放回碗里，伸手摸到枕下。

pairs.target: nà zhāng zhǐ zuóyè bèi tā yā le jìnqù .
pairs.english: She had tucked the paper underneath the night before.
pairs.hanzi: 那张纸昨夜被她压了进去。

pairs.target: biānjiǎo yǐjīng gān le , zhéhén què niándé hěn láo .
pairs.english: Its edges had dried, but the folds were stuck fast.
pairs.hanzi: 边角已经干了，折痕却黏得很牢。

pairs.target: tā zhǐ niēzhù wàitou nà yìjiǎo , méiyǒu yìng jiē .
pairs.english: She only held that exposed corner, without prying it open.
pairs.hanzi: 她只捏住外头那一角，没有硬揭。

pairs.target: gé zhe báobáode zhǐ , fǎngfú hái néng mō chū zìjǐ xiě míngzì shí shǐ de jìn .
pairs.english: Through the thin paper, she could almost still feel the pressure she'd used when writing her name.
pairs.hanzi: 隔着薄薄的纸，仿佛还能摸出自己写名字时使的劲。
